verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a first-party sandbox, a self-contained environment that mirrors production and handles API requests without touching live accounts. The agent toolkit and cart APIs run on the same PayPal REST surface, so the sandbox plausibly covers agent workflows. However, no agent-specific doc confirms sandbox mode for the toolkit, the MCP server, Store Sync, or the Agent Ready ACP/UCP paths, and the link to agent commerce rests on a summarizing inference rather than explicit agent docs. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode docs for the agent toolkit and MCP server, sandbox support for Store Sync and the Agent Ready ACP/UCP checkout flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent testing in the sandbox
